# SF game design and review

For SF game discussion, implementation, and code review, read and apply the
[game-design skill](../../.claude/skills/game-design/SKILL.md) and its
[shared framing](../knowledge/game-design.md). For shared Eleventy configuration, apply it
only to changes affecting the game.

Use the exact anchors World, Physics, Traffic, Goals, UI, and Data. Changes may span anchors.
Check the player's feedback loop and, where relevant, each traffic actor's observations,
decisions, motion, and recorded outcomes. Keep road safety and measured world geometry
explicit. Use the existing review finding format; report actionable issues and evidence
rather than forcing findings or repeating six headings. Refer to the canonical sources for
definitions, examples, references, and scope.
